title: GTA 6 has real cheats, but you have to earn them
yt_title: GTA 6 has real cheats… but you have to EARN them 🎮
description: GTA 6 has cheats: D-pad codes on PS5 and Xbox that unlock only after you finish the main story, plus a challenge for each cheat (PC Gamer and GameSpot guides). The money cheat reportedly gives $250,000 (input reported by GameSpot: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right; not yet confirmed by a second outlet). Old GTA 5 cheats (like PAINKILLER) do not work: GTA 6 has brand new codes. Which cheat will you unlock first? Sources: https://www.gamespot.com/articles/all-gta-6-cheats-and-how-to-unlock-them/ and https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-cheats-list/
rumor_note: Unconfirmed (one reliable outlet so far): the money cheat input and its $250,000 amount.
